punchline: Two decades ago the dealer knew the Malibu better than the buyer did; today the buyer reading enthusiast sites may know it better than the dealer.
thirty_sec: A generation ago a Chevy dealer knew far more about the Malibu than the buyer. Today the buyer reads enthusiast sites and may know more than the dealer. Pink adds seller beware to buyer beware, and says what remains for the seller is clarity: spotting problems the buyer has not noticed.
